title: Remainder that follows the dividend
description: Divide a by b with the quotient q rounded toward zero (the fraction is dropped), and return the remainder r = a - b*q. Because of the rounding, r is 0 or has the same sign as a, and |r| < |b|. For example -7 and 2 give q = -3 and r = -1; 7 and -2 give q = -3 and r = 1. b is never 0 and may be negative.
notes: Experiment int_division: hidden tests use negative operands; the description states truncation toward zero in words. The ref.zehn is written with int.div_floor / int.div_trunc / int.rem_euclid so it is valid under int_ops=operators and int_ops=explicit.
